pemanduan.name: Half-Day Guided Tour
pemanduan.desc: About 4 hours with a local guide: Batak culture, history, and Samosir cuisine. Meeting point agreed at booking.

penitipan.name: Luggage Storage (Travel Without Your Suitcase)
penitipan.desc: Your suitcase is photographed from four sides, fitted with a numbered seal, and you receive a receipt. Pick it up at the same point.

antarDekat.name: Luggage Delivery — Near Zone
antarDekat.desc: Delivery between guesthouses within the Tuk Tuk – Tomok – Ambarita zone.

antarLintas.name: Luggage Delivery — Cross Zone
antarLintas.desc: Delivery as far as Simanindo or Pangururan.

fleksibel.name: Flexible Tour
fleksibel.desc: Bundle: a half-day guided tour + one near-zone luggage delivery. Cheaper than buying separately.

mystery.desc: A themed surprise tour. The order of the locations is secret and revealed one day before (H-1) via WhatsApp.

help.title: Help & Reviews
help.subtitle: Frequently asked questions, quick contact, and a place to rate us after using the service.

faq.a: Pick a service on the Booking page and follow 4 steps: choose a service, date & location, your details, then payment. If you get stuck, the admin is ready to help via WhatsApp.
Payment is manual via bank transfer or e-wallet. After paying, upload your payment proof in the last step or send it via WhatsApp.
Your suitcase is photographed from four sides, fitted with a numbered seal, and you receive a digital receipt. Handover only happens after matching the receipt number and your identity.

faq.q: How long can I store luggage?
faq.a: Storage is charged per suitcase per day. The daily quota is 20 suitcases — book early to be sure.
A themed tour: Heritage Trail or Lake Sunset. The order of the locations is secret and revealed one day before (H-1) via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Does a referral code give a discount?
faq.a: No. Referral codes from customers or partners are only recorded for our recommendation program and partner commissions — public prices stay the same.
